svg.text: Mental health clinical trials pipeline · weekly AWS refresh
Two scheduled Lambdas download ClinicalTrials.gov and Health Canada every Monday and store dated snapshots in S3. A third loads each refresh into PostgreSQL for Power BI;
Athena queries Parquet copies in place, and the Streamlit app reads the latest counts.
Not in the stack: tools/classify_why_stopped.py runs from your PC and calls Amazon Bedrock (Nova Micro) to label why trials stopped; tools/setup_database.py creates the database users once.
AWS service icons: official AWS Architecture Icons (aws.amazon.com/architecture/icons). Diagram drawn for this project from its SAM template.
